entries.name: Anti-Mage
lines: Counterspell negates Dark Willow's high magic burst damage. Its active blocks Cursed Crown.

Blink allows Anti-Mage to dodge Terrorize during its long cast animation, as well as avoiding the obstacles from Bramble Maze. On the other hand, if Anti-Mage gets caught inside Bramble Maze, he's unable to Blink away.
Dark Willow's chained magic burst requires a lot of mana, setting her up for damaging Mana Voids.

entries.name: Axe
lines: Berserker's Call forces Dark Willow to attack, cancelling Shadow Realm.

entries.name: Arc Warden
lines: Magnetic Field lets Arc Warden or allies evade Dark Willow's shadow realm attacks. The duration of the evasion can be extended with the clone.
Spark Wraith also exploits Dark Willow's low mobility.

entries.name: Bristleback
lines: Quill Spray's constant AoE damage will hit Dark Willow even in Shadow Realm. Its automatic damage will hurt her if she tries to get close and use Bedlam.

entries.name: Drow Ranger
lines: Gust can hit Dark Willow beyond a defensive Bramble Maze, and before she gets close enough to hit Drow Ranger with Bedlam.
Drow Ranger's long range allows her to hit Dark Willow's team without venturing into her Bramble Maze.

entries.name: Ember Spirit
lines: Flame Guard blocks Dark Willow's magical burst damage, and harms her if she tries to get close to attack with Bedlam.
Sleight of Fist and Fire Remnant makes it hard for Dark Willow to fully disable Ember Spirit.

entries.name: Juggernaut
lines: Blade Fury dispels most of Dark Willow's abilities, allowing Juggernaut to pass through Bramble Maze and cancel out Cursed Crown before the stun occurs.
However, Dark Willow can tank Omnislash with Shadow Realm. As she is a valid target, but invulnerable to right clicks.

entries.name: Lifestealer
lines: Rage protects and dispels all of Dark Willow's abilities.

entries.name: Nyx Assassin
lines: Nyx Assassin's high burst damage can be the bane of Dark Willow, as her low health makes it difficult to survive long enough to escape through Shadow Realm.
Spiked Carapace can be triggered by walking deliberately into Bramble Maze, leaving Dark Willow stunned and defenseless.

entries.name: Oracle
lines: Fortune's End not being disjointable is almost an ensured disable if Dark Willow tries to escape with Shadow Realm. Dispels Cursed Crown and Terrorize.
Fate's Edict negates all her magic damage in case she catches a single hero.
False Promise's strong dispel removes Dark Willow's disables.

entries.name: Puck
lines: All of Puck's abilities are area-targeted, and will hit Dark Willow when she uses Shadow Realm.
Illusory Orb allows Puck to bypass Bramble Maze, close the gap and silence Dark Willow with Waning Rift.
Phase Shift helps Puck dodge attacks charged by Shadow Realm, and is easily timed against Terrorize's long cast time.

entries.name: Pudge
lines: Rot and Meat Hook hits Dark Willow even when she uses Shadow Realm.
Flesh Heap reduces Dark Willow's magic burst damage.

entries.name: Riki
lines: Smoke Screen prevents Dark Willow from using her abilities, rendering her defenseless and unable to deal any serious damage.
Blink Strike lets Riki jump past Bramble Maze.

entries.name: Silencer
lines: Last Word and Arcane Curse have the range to hit Dark Willow beyond Bramble Maze.
Global Silence renders Dark Willow useless in teamfights.

entries.name: Storm Spirit
lines: Ball Lightning allows Storm Spirit to bypass Bramble Maze into the backline, and zip back into battle if he gets hit by Terrorize.

entries.name: Skywrath Mage
lines: Ancient Seal instantly shuts down Dark Willow's abilities, rendering her defenseless against his high burst damage spells, while she cannot cast spells of her own.
Mystic Flare deals immense burst damage in an area, damaging Dark Willow through Shadow Realm.
Heroes who can silence will shut down Dark Willow entirely: Death Prophet, Silencer, Drow Ranger
Heroes with high burst damage and Black King Bar can take down Dark Willow quickly: Phantom Assassin, Sven, Wraith King
Infused Raindrops reduces the early game burst damage potential of Shadow Realm.
Town Portal Scroll can be activated immediately after Cursed Crown is cast to teleport out before the stun hits.
Cloak greatly reduces Dark Willow's magical damage.
Glimmer Cape reduces Dark Willow's magical damage against the owner, and can be activated to create a shield against Dark Willow's magical damage, or evade it completely via invisibility.
Dragon Lance helps ranged heroes attack over Bramble Maze.
Blade Mail reflects Dark Willow's high burst damage back to her, killing her quickly due to her low health.
Black King Bar completely negates most of Dark Willow's spells, protecting the caster against her disables and significantly reducing her damage output.
Bloodthorn will not only silence her, but allow allies to make short work of Dark Willow's low health.
Helm of the Dominator's creep helps tank Bedlam and Bramble maze.
Lotus Orb dispels Cursed Crown delay and Terrorize from your teammates. Additionally, Lotus Orb will reflect Cursed Crown back at Dark Willow.

entries.name: Bloodseeker
lines: Bramble Maze greatly hinders Bloodseeker's ability to run around in teamfights and pick off dying allies.
Shadow Realm prevents Bloodseeker from attacking dark Willow, allowing her to safely teleport away.

entries.name: Faceless Void
lines: Terrorize forces Faceless Void out of Chronosphere.

entries.name: Monkey King
lines: Terrorize forces Monkey King out of Wukong's Command.

entries.name: Meepo
lines: Casting Bramble Maze on top of Meepo guarantees a root, as it is nearly impossible to leave the thorns with all of Meepo's clones.
Terrorize and Cursed Crown offer great disables against the grouped Meepos and can prevent them from using Poof to escape.

entries.name: Spirit Breaker
lines: Bramble Maze stops Charge of Darkness in its tracks. Its very long duration means it can be used as an obstacle to block off an incoming Spirit Break during teamfights.
Shadow Realm and Bedlam can be activated when Dark Willow sees Charge of Darkness coming, preventing Spirit Breaker from using Nether Strike after the initial stun.

entries.name: Timbersaw
lines: Bramble Maze prevents Timbersaw from Timber Chaining away without getting rooted.
Cursed Crown can still catch Timbersaw if he Timber Chains away.
Reactive Armor offers little protection against Dark Willow's high magical damage.

entries.name: Troll Warlord
lines: Dark Willow's burst damage and stun prevents Troll Warlord from approaching her until he has Black King Bar.
Troll Warlord's lack of burst damage makes it hard for him to kill Dark Willow before she slips into Shadow Realm.

entries.name: Windranger
lines: Windrun does not protect Windranger from Cursed Crown's stun or Dark Willow's magical nukes.
Focus Fire cannot target Dark Willow in Shadow Realm and will be interrupted if targeted earlier, wasting the ultimate.
Heroes who rely on abilities for mobility might become more vulnerable if forced to retreat on foot due to Terrorize

entries.name: Axe
lines: Berserker's Call can be used to stop Terrorized enemies in their tracks, forcing them to face Axe, while they cannot attack. Terrorized enemies are easier to hit, as they cannot make evasive maneuvers.

Terrorize can be used on enemies under the effect of Berserker's Call to fear multiple stationary enemies at once and extend the stun duration. Enemies cannot attack while under the effect of Terrorize.

entries.name: Ember Spirit
lines: Enemies caught in Bramble Maze are easy pickings for all of Ember Spirit's AoE damage abilities.

entries.name: Invoker
lines: Cursed Crown and Bramble Maze long disable time helps Invoker land abilities like Sun Strike.

entries.name: Juggernaut
lines: Cursed Crown and Bramble Maze can help Juggernaut get early kills in lane with Blade Fury.
Terrorize can potentially keep enemies grouped during Blade Fury and Omnislash.

entries.name: Lina
lines: Bramble Maze helps Lina land Light Strike Array, and prevents enemies from escaping other nukes.

entries.name: Magnus
lines: Magnus can use Skewer to force enemies through multiple Bramble Maze brambles, stacking multiple instances of the effect to deal high damage to the target.
Dark Willow can use Terrorize to easily hit multiple enemies to extend the stun duration of Reverse Polarity.

entries.name: Mirana
lines: Cursed Crown's delayed stun helps Mirana aim and land Sacred Arrows.
Leap and Starstorm are useful when chasing after Terrorized enemies.

entries.name: Phoenix
lines: Terrorized enemies' linear retreat make them ideal targets for the effect paths of Icarus Dive and Sun Ray.
Bramble Maze prevents enemies from fleeing Supernova's damage and stun radius.
Terrorize can save Phoenix during Supernova, if the enemy team decides to attack the egg instead of running away.

entries.name: Puck
lines: Terrorize can force a group of enemies to break Dream Coil, stunning them and causing them to take extra damage.

entries.name: Pudge
lines: Pudge can use Meat Hook to force enemies through multiple Bramble Maze brambles, stacking multiple instances of the effect to deal high damage to the target.

entries.name: Warlock
lines: Chaotic Offering and Upheaval synergize with Bramble Maze and Terrorize to dominate the battlefield in Warlock's favor.

entries.name: Weaver
lines: Shukuchi lets Weaver to pass through multiple enemies hindered by Bramble Maze, and catch up to Terrorized enemies.
The Swarm's linear path allows the Beetles to latch onto all enemies affected by Terrorize.
Heroes who deal high damage while moving can kill Terrorized enemies just by running alongside them: Leshrac, Razor, Death Prophet, Windranger
Heroes fast enough to chase down Terrorized enemies as they run away can take advantage of the situation to deal more damage: Slardar, Storm Spirit, Blood finding, Pangolier, Weaver
Heroes who create obstacles during teamfights synergize well with Bramble Maze, and the forced movement from Terrorize: Earthshaker, Jakiro

entries.name: Clarity
lines: Clarity helps Dark Willow play more aggressively in the early game with supply of mana.

entries.name: Tango
lines: Tango supplements Dark Willow's low natural health with regeneration.

entries.name: Healing Salve
lines: Healing Salve restores health to keep Dark Willow alive.

entries.name: Iron Branch
lines: Iron Branch combines with Tango to heal more, or builds into Magic Wand.

entries.name: Enchanted Mango
lines: Enchanted Mango restores mana for Dark Willow to use abilities in the early game.

entries.name: Observer Ward
lines: Observer Ward provides vision on the enemies so Dark Willow and allies can gank.

entries.name: Boots of Speed
lines: Boots of Speed increase movement speed to chase or escape.

entries.name: Wind Lace
lines: Wind Lace helps Dark Willow keep up with enemies during ganks, and builds into Eul's Scepter of Divinity.

entries.name: Magic Stick
lines: Magic Stick can save Dark Willow in an emergency by restoring health and mana.

entries.name: Magic Wand
lines: Magic Wand gives Dark Willow a quick mana and health restoration.

entries.name: Arcane Boots
lines: Arcane Boots help Dark Willow use her magical nukes more often, as she has five active abilities with high mana costs.

entries.name: Eul's Scepter of Divinity
lines: Eul's Scepter of Divinity works well with any of Dark Willow's abilities: setting up Bramble Maze's root and Terrorize's fear, buying time for Cursed Crown to stun and Shadow Realm to peak in damage, removing an enemy for Bedlam to concentrate on others, and combining with Shadow Realm for longer period of untargetability. It also provides intelligence and mana regeneration for her to use said abilities.

entries.name: Blink Dagger
lines: Blink Dagger helps Dark Willow get close to enemies to land as many Bedlam hits as possible, and allows her to get behind enemies for Terrorize. If trying to escape from enemies, Shadow Realm may help Dark Willow survive the 3 second cooldown and blink to safety.

entries.name: Glimmer Cape
lines: Glimmer Cape grants Dark Willow a layer of protection with invisibility and magic resistance, so she can stay on top of the enemies when using Bedlam.

entries.name: Scythe of Vyse
lines: Scythe of Vyse provides a large damage boost and a strong single-target hex to complement her natural AoE disables.

entries.name: File:Ultimate Scepter icon.png
lines: File:Ultimate Scepter icon.png Ultimate Scepter provides massive attack damage and compiled with a moon shard transitions dark willow in to a late game carry.

entries.name: Phase Boots
lines: Phase Boots allow Dark Willow to keep up with enemies while using Bedlam.

entries.name: Bottle
lines: Bottle facilitates rune control, offsetting the high mana cost of Dark Willow's abilities.

entries.name: Kaya
lines: Kaya increases Dark Willow's burst damage, and reduces some of her high mana costs.

entries.name: Force Staff
lines: Force Staff helps Dark Willow escape, stay next to enemies during Bedlam, or push a fleeing enemy with Cursed Crown into their team.

entries.name: Spirit Vessel
lines: Spirit Vessel sustains Dark Willow and teammates with heal, and it can also help in ganks by countering enemy healing and dealing some damage.

entries.name: Rod of Atos
lines: Rod of Atos applies root to keep the target within range of Bedlam.

entries.name: Linken's Sphere
lines: Linken's Sphere protects Dark Willow from single target disables, which can kill her in the late game.

entries.name: Aeon Disk
lines: Aeon Disk protects Dark Willow from high damage nukes and initiations with strong dispel and damage reduction, giving her 2.5 seconds to use all of her abilities to help in teamfights or to disengage.

pros: Fulfills both support and carry roles.
playstyle.text: Dark Willow is a sinister spellcaster, capable of dishing out bursts of magical damage with the help of Jex, her companion wisp. She excels at crowd control, entangling foes in the thorns of Bedlam or forcing them to flee with Terrorize. Despite her potent spells, Dark Willow's high Charisma stat makes her quite invulnerable, and her short early game cooldowns don't require judicious use of her ultimate abilities.
cons: Very hard to learn, similar to playing 5 Invokers at once

lines: Put value points into Bedlam and Terrorize early to protect your team and lock down enemies.
Bedlam deals heavy damage to zone out the enemy in lane, as well as helping Dark Willow escape.
Buy mana to cast more ultimates. Invest in so much mana, that Outhouse Decorator and Keeper of the Light become Yellow with envy.
Focus on leveling Bedlam, Bedlam, and Bedlam to deal magical damage in ganks.
Sell seashells.
Amass gold.
Create a monopoly and grow it by inducing a sense of scarcity.
Become the richest creature to ever do it.
Destroy your items after dying to dispose of the evidence.
Ensure that the IRS never finds you.
Dark Willow excels as a support due to her many disables and nukes.
Dark Willow's magical burst damage requires her to get close to her targets, exposing her to retaliation.
More tips needed.
Use Bramble Maze to block off narrow points, such as stairs or the Roshan Pit.
Use Bramble Maze sparingly in the early game as it has a long cooldown.
Use Bramble Maze as an initiation tool, centering the inner circle of brambles around the target.
Bramble Maze's formation is always the same.
Cast Bramble Maze slightly off-center to put a single bramble in the enemy's way, or block off a narrow path.
Use Bramble Maze as a protective zone for Dark Willow and her allies.
Use Bramble Maze pre-emptively before a teamfight since it has long duration.
Zone out last-hitters or set up early kills by placing Bramble Maze directly on the enemy hero.
More tips needed.
Shadow Realm's damage scales well in the early game, so max it out first.
Use Shadow Realm to harass enemies in lane.
Use Shadow Realm's long attack range to finish off enemies escaping.
Shadow Realm disjoints and makes Dark Willow untargetable by anyone, including herself and her allies.
Shadow Realm does not protect from AoE abilities, meaning that area nukes and disables like Sanity's Eclipse and Rolling Thunder can still hurt Dark Willow.
When ganking, use Shadow Realm with Bedlam to deal high burst damage, and to avoid being disabled by the target.
Use Shadow Realm before channeling Town Portal Scroll to increase Dark Willow's chance of escape because the ability protects her from unit-target disables, such as Malefice.
You can use items like Eul's Scepter of Divinity, or work with abilities like Disruption that hold the enemies in place, buying time for Shadow Realm to charge up damage.
More tips needed.
Use Cursed Crown followed by abilities and items like Eul's Scepter of Divinity to pin target in place, eliminating much of the stun delay.
Use Cursed Crown in the middle of teamfights, or after placing Bramble Maze to stun multiple enemies.
Use Cursed Crown on aggressor to dissuade them from chasing Dark Willow or allies.
In the later stage of the game, enemy heroes will have plenty of time to use Black King Bar before Cursed Crown's stun goes off. So, try to save it for heroes without spell immunity.
As Cursed Crown is counting down, it shows the stun area with faint visual effect.
More tips needed.
Bedlam deals more damage against a single target.
Dark Willow can choose to use Bedlam to clear creep waves as it has short cooldown.
Use Bedlam with Shadow Realm, allowing Dark Willow to stay close to enemies without them retaliating.
Use Bedlam with Eul's Scepter of Divinity to deal damage while avoiding incoming damage.
Use abilities and items like Eul's Scepter of Divinity to remove one enemy so Bedlam has one less target to attack.
During Bedlam, the visual effect around Jex indicates its attack range.

Bedlam is a poor ability for teamfights as it requires Dark Willow to get dangerously close to the enemy and loses effectiveness against multiple targets. Use Terrorize and your basic abilities to control the fight, saving Bedlam to pick off survivors.
More tips needed.
Terrorize applies fear to make enemies run toward their fountain.
Position Dark Willow behind the enemy team to catch terrorized enemies with Bramble Maze and Bedlam.
Try not to use Terrorize and make enemies run away from allied abilities like Chaotic Offering or Death Ward.
Use Terrorize to protect allies and disengage from a losing fight.
Use Terrorize to counter-initiate as enemies have committed powerful and expensive disables like Black Hole, Stone Gaze, Vacuum, or Dream Coil, ruining their combo and saving caught allies.
Use Terrorize to waste powerful enemy abilities like Metamorphosis, Chemical Rage, Shapeshift, Guardian Angel, Insatiable Hunger, and Strafe.
Use Terrorize to stop enemy channelers like Pugna, Witch Doctor, or Crystal Maiden, even if they gain invisibility with Glimmer Cape.
Since terrorized enemies cannot spread out, use Cursed Crown's area stun to disable multiple targets as Terrorize ends, or use it to herd enemies into Bramble Maze.
Try to aim Terrorize to make some heroes run away, so your team can slaughter the remaining ones.
More tips needed.

talents.text: Level 10 Talent Intelligence increased from +10 to +12
Level 15 Talent Terrorize Cooldown Reduction increased from 15s to 20s

bio:
Children love telling stories about the whimsical adventures of fairies... That’s because children don’t know that most fairies are spiteful jerks. And in the world of spiteful fairies there are few names spoken of with more contempt than Mireska Sunbreeze.

Born to a fae merchant king, Mireska grew up in Revtel; a cutthroat nation where manipulation and murder were the norm. But while she was quite adept at navigating the etiquette, unspoken laws, and social rituals that permeated every element of her life, she found the whole thing rather boring.

So, Mireska did what most rebellious children do: burn down her family estate and set off with her pet wisp Jex to live the life of a wandering grifter.
trivia: Dark Willow is sometimes labeled in the game files as Sylph and Fairy, her early working names.
Dark Willow's accent is heavily based on those found in Celtic and Gaelic countries, mostly Wales, Ireland and Scotland.

abilities.description: Dark Willow creates a 500 AoE maze of 8 brambles that grow in the target area after 0.3 seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts 12 seconds.
abilities.name: Bramble Maze

notes: Spells which require vision cannot affect Dark Willow in the Shadow Realm.
abilities.scepter: Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.
abilities.description: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable.  Her next attack has 600 bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after 3 seconds.
abilities.name: Shadow Realm

abilities.description: Dark Willow casts an ancient fae curse on the target. After a delay, the target and nearby enemies are stunned.
abilities.name: Cursed Crown
abilities.shard: Cursed Crown creates 4 brambles in a 175 radius around the target after the counter ends. Triggers even upon dispel. Cursed Crown cooldown reduced by 1.5 seconds.

wikiNotes.text: Terrorize is inactive during Bedlam.
Terrorize is also inactive during its cast time and stays inactive until Jex fully returns to Dark Willow after terrorizing enemies.
This means Terrorize cannot be cast again until Jex returns from a previous cast.
During the cast time, Jex appears 300 range above Dark Willow and then travels to the target point at a speed of 2000, and returns at a speed of 600.
The visual effect at the target area during the cast time/effect delay is visible to allies only. The sound is audible to everyone.
Applies fear on all hit enemies within the radius, making them run towards their fountain and preventing them from acting.
When hitting neutral creeps, they retreat to their camps instead.
Exposes all affected targets, but does not provide True Sight over them.
The ability itself provides no vision, but Jex has 600 ground vision which it provides during the duration.

This ability's cast point is not modified when acquired. Terrorize can still be cast while Bedlam is active. However, when both abilities are acquired via Spell Steal, they get turned inactive as normal.

abilities.description: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies.  Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.
abilities.name: Bedlam

abilities.description: Dark Willow gains 20% bonus Health and Mana Regeneration, increased to 100% while she is untargetable or invulnerable.

abilities.name: Terrorize

name: Dark Willow
short: Has an arsenal of disables at her disposal
